answer: Tenure-gated privilege unlock resists sybils: a freshly minted identity sits on a probationary ledge and cannot vote, earn, or grade until it survives T epochs of continuously attested honest work. A nebula of fakes spun up in one burst is inert for the whole maturation window — powerless and exposed to detection throughout — so a flash-army buys nothing until each head independently threads T epochs of real participation. An honest newcomer waits one period once; a farm must carry every fake through the full gate. Precondition: tenure counts only independently-attested activity.
